card.line: Lo-debar was a town in Gilead, east of the Jordan, where Machir lived and where Jonathan's son Mephibosheth stayed before David sent for him.

moments.title: David sends for Mephibosheth
moments.text: Ziba tells David that Jonathan's son is in Lo-debar at the house of Machir. King David has him brought from Machir's house in Lo-debar.
